articles.title: Context Scaling: A New Frontier of AI Scaling
articles.summary: arXiv:2611.33160v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Many failures of deployed AI arise not from weak inference but from a mismatch between the state a task depends on and the context available when the system acts. Relevant user state, repository revisions, tool traces, sensor readings, or environment changes may be unavailable, distorted, or poorly selected. articles.title: Constraint-Aware Test-Time Scoring for LLM and VLM Candidate Selection
articles.summary: arXiv:2611.33161v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: When an LLM or VLM produces several candidate answers, picking the best one usually relies on the model's own confidence, a learned judge model, or a domain check. articles.title: AutoformBench: A Lean Formalization Benchmark for Advanced Mathematics

articles.title: General-Purpose Decision Models for AI Configuration Tuning
articles.summary: arXiv:2611.33190v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: AI configuration tuning searches for settings that improve the performance of AI systems under a limited budget. Existing tuners use different sampling and search policies, making the choice of decision strategy central to both tuning quality and cost. articles.title: What, Who, and When: Structured Harm Assessment for Mental Health Safety via Short Reasoning
articles.summary: arXiv:2611.33263v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The growing use of large language models (LLMs) for mental health support raises important safety concerns. Existing guard models primarily identify categories of harmful content, often overlooking the context needed to determine an appropriate response. articles.title: Certify What You Plant: Shortcut-Free Proof Depth in Logical Reasoning Data
articles.summary: arXiv:2611.33303v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Procedurally generated logic problems are used to both evaluate and train reasoning in language models.
